summary: A survival base-building floor tile, 3.0 x 3.0 m and 0.15 m thick: fourteen sawn, slightly warped deck boards… options tier; sockets socket_top, socket_edge_front, socket_edge_back, socket_edge_left, socket_edge_right.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.base_floor_wood or place "prefab": "base_floor_wood" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d().
